bod ljongs kyisgyu rtsal/ shā pi sa 8/rdo/ non bu lda mu da sa/gling lnga khyab spel dpe skrun khang /

twe stso ciri dinya tsho rwa rwa rngo 4——mtsha sdusang rwa —tsho ske ri 7 ri gleng gzhi/ 1gcig bod sgyu rtsal gyi rig gnas zhing sa/ /gnyis/ lkog gyur can gyi bon po'i rig gnas/ 3gsum/ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi gzhi rtsa'i gnas tshul/ 9bzhi/ bod sgyu rtsal gyi brjod bya gtso bo/ 23le'u dang po/ bod kyi bzo skrun sgyu rtsal/ 37gcig gna' bo'i bang so'i bzo sgrun/ 38gnyis/ dgon pa'i 'dzugs skrun/ 45gsum/ pho brang bzo skrun/ 62bzhi/ bod kyi khang khyim/ 78le'u gnyis pa/ bod kyi brkos brnyan sgyu rtsal/ 84dang po/ bod brgyud nang bstan 'jim brkos sgyu rtsal gyi 'phel rgyas gnas tshul/ 86gnyis/ lcags rigs bzo brkos kyi brtsams chos 95gsum/ 'jim sku'i brtsams chos skor/ /()6bzhi/ rdo brkos brtsams chos /5

le'u gsum/ bod kyi ri mo'i sgyu rtsal/ 129gcig sgyu rtsal gyi rnam pa gtso bo/ 131gnyis/ 'bri rtsal gyi khyad chos/ 146gsum/ mdzes rtsal dang bris rgyun/ 161bzhi/ deng rabs kyi dpe ris/ 180le'u ngayon ba/ bod kyi dmangs khrod lag shes bzo rtsal/ 187gcig rdza chas bzo rtsal 188gnyis/ lcags rigs bzo rtsal 193gsum/ 'bag bzo'i sgyu rtsal/ 197bzhi/ dpar brko par 'debs kyi bzo rtsal 200lnga/ 'khal thag dang shing chas bzo rtsal 204

gcig bod sgru rtsal gyi rig gyi gyi rke —dzo zuji —rngo gnas zhing sa/bltos bcas mi grangs mang ba'i bod 0ngas recha rnga che kyi grong brdal dang grong tsho/ yang na mi med dben pa'i rtswa thang dang / ri tshogs tshar du dngar ba'i lung mdo dang / ga'an yang rlabs sngon yam yom du g.yo ba'i mtshe'u gang gleng sa'e/yin yang phyogs mtshams kun du sgyu rtsal gyi rang mdangs rtag tu 'phro bzhin yod de/ 7—ri bor brten nas bzhengs shing gser 'od tswardolam lam du 'phro ba'i dgon pa'i 'dzugs r+shaskrun dang sa rgod thang stong gi brag gzar khrod kyi gna' bo'i brag brkos yi ge dang brag brkos ri mo/ lung mdo dang mtshe'u ngogs su lhab lhub du g.yo ba'i dar lcog ri rtser 1grang nger 'gying ba'i gna' bo'i mkhar rdzong /lha khang nang gi kha dog rnam par bkra ba'i ngo mtshar can gyi ldebs ris dang 'jim brnyan/thang ga de min mtha' med rtswa thang steng gi lhug por 'phyo ba'i bro gar sogs phyogs thams cad du mtho sgang du gnas bca' ba'i bod mi rnams de sngon slebs pa'i gnas shig

yin na khong tsho'i blo gros dang shes rab kyi bzo rtsal gang sar bzhag yod pa yin/ tshad gzhi nges can zhig gi steng nas bshad na de rnams ni bod kyi rig gnas kyi ches drang thad kyi snang 'char zhig yin pa red/bod kyi sgyu rtsal gyi byung 'phel la da lta'i bar du lo ngo lnga stong lhag gi lo rgyus yod cing / lo rgyus ma byung gong gi sgyu rtsal lam gdod ma'i chos lugs te bon po'i chos lugs dang 'brel ba dam zab ldan pa yin/ de'i rjes kyi 'phel rgyas la bod brgyud nang chos rig gnas grub cha gtso bor gyur bas mi rigs dang sa gnas kyi khyad chosashugs drag ldan pa red/ chi ne ma k+ṣiṃ

gnyis/ skog gyur can gyi bon po'i rigs gnas/bon chos ni mdo dbus mtho sgang gi lo rgyus ma byung gong gi dpal yon khrod kyi rang sa'i chos lugs gtso bo yin la spyi lo'i sngon gyi dus rabs lnga bar bod kyi nub phyogs sa khul zhang zhung yul nas ston pa gshen rabs mi bo ches gsar gtod mdzad cing /srid lo'i dus 'go'i snga gzhug nas shar phyogs su 'phel 'go brtsams pa dang der 'thud nas gtsang dang lha sa'i sa khul yongs su khyab pa ma zad/ btsan po'i dus skabs kyi dus gong mar 'phel rgyas phyin nas yang rtser son cing btsan po'i dus gong ma'i skabs kyi spyi tshogs kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor dang rig gnas sogs phyogs gang thad du phal cher bdag dbang sgyur/bon po rnams kyi 'dod tshul du ‘‘lha mang dad bkur ’’dang ‘‘bya dngos yod dgur tshe srog yod par bzhed ’pa yin/ yangs pa'i sa gzhi dang bstar ba'i ri klung /nyi zla gza' skar/ char rlung dang thogs cha/gcan gzan dang 'dab chags/ gtsang bo dang chu klung tshang mar rang byung las 'das ba'i spyang rig gis khengs shing mi rnams kyi skyes rga na 'chi dang legs nyes skyid sdug sogs bdag tu bzung yod pas mi rnams kyis sngon dpag thub pa dang kha lo bsgyur bar thabs

shes dben pa'i nus pa khyad mtshar ldan pa zhig yin/lha 'dre yis mi'i rigs dbang du bsgyur yod pa ma zad tha na mi rang nyid kyang lha 'dres gsar bzo byas bar 'dod/ dus der thu bhod spyi tshogs dbang sgyur byed pa'i btsan po rnams ni ‘‘gnam gyi sras ’’te lha yi sras po yin par 'dod/ btsan po ni steng phyogs lha yi yul nas mi yul du phebs shing sku gshegs rjes su gnam gyi them skas sam dmu thag la 'jus nas phyir lha yul du phebs 'gro ba yin/ mi'i las dbang yang lus steng du gnas yod pa'i dgra lha dang pho lha gnyis kyis kha lo sgyur ba yin la lha gcig gi skyabs bcol nus pa nyams pa yin na mi ni 'jig rten dang kha bral nas 'gro ba yin/ mi shi rjes mchod sbyin mdzad sgo gzab rgyas 'tshogs nas 'pho ba byed pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni bon po rnams kyis mi la 'jig rten 'di dang phyi ma gnyis yod pa'i 'dod tshul 'dzin pa red/'jig rten phyi ma ni sdug bsngal dang mun nag gi 'jig rten yin la mi shi rjes su mchod 'bul byas na da gzod gang de'i rnam shes mun nag dang sdug bsngal gyi 'jig rten nas phyir drangs nas mtho ris lha yul du 'gro thub pa yin/ lta ba 'di dag yod pa'i rmang gzhi'i steng du g.yung drung bon gyi gdod ma'i lha 'dre ma lag dang lha bsu 'dre 'dul gyi mdzad sgo cha tshang zhig

yod la rnga ma yar 'khyil yod/ g.yag gi logs g.yon du mi gnyis brkos yod/ de'i khrod kyi mi gcig gis phyu ba gyon zhing rkang pa rkyal nas langs yod/lag g.yas pa rum la bcug nas g.yon pas dar shing ring po gcig bzung yod pa yin/ 'og gi g.yon nas g.yas phyogs su zla ba dang nyi ma/ pho ma'i mtshan ma sogs yod/ g.yas phyogs kyi dma' sar mi dang /nyi ma/ rdza snod sogs yod/ g.yag gi logs g.yas gzhogs su nya chen po cig brkos yod pa de mgo rnga sprel nas zlum dbyibs ltar mgo la bya 'bag gyon zhing / mi'i gong 'og tu nya chung chung gsum rer bris yod/ nya chen po de'i g.yon 'og tu zhabs bro brgyag pa'i mi bzhi brkos yod la rdza snod bcu re gral ltar bsgrigs shing rnam pa 'dra la tshang ma'i kha che zhing gong kha mtho la/ zhabs gor ba/ lto ba'i rgyan ris la gzhung thig gi khra ris yod/ri nibyu — ru4 //zhi gi nga tsho diri sku ri ༷ dzo hūṃristonedhedzharngar ༅ citrīsmo // / /jichi ni/ji tsha4 snang ci

sangs rgyas chos lugs ni phyi phyogs nas/ dar yong ba'i chos lugs zhig yin zhing / bod rgya' srong btsan sgam pos dam chos spel bar rgyab skyor chen po thob na'ang dus der go gnas gco bo zin pa'i srol rgyun bon po'i nus shugs kyis ngo rgol byas par brten sangs rgyas chos lugs khyab spel byed par bkag rgya chen po thebs shing lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi rtsig rmang ‘‘nyin mo mi'i brtsigs na mtshan mo 'dres bshig pas chos spel mkhan dang chos rgol mkhan phyogs sanyis kyis stobs shugs 'gran res byas nas stag seng kha sprod du gyur/ de nas dus rabs gcig gi rjes kyi btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi dus skabs su slebs dus bon po'i stobs shugs rim gyis nyams te spyi lo 76 2lor bod kyi mchog gsum kun 'dzoms kyi dgon pa thog dang po ste bsam yas dgon pa lho zla ru phyag btab pas sangs rgyas chos lugs gangs can ljongs su gzhi brtan zab mo tshugs pa red/ yin yang btsan po rim byon gyis sangs rgyas chos lugs la rgyab skyob shugs chen mdzad nas dge 'dun pa srid kyi las don du zhugs chog pa byas shing ‘ khyim tshang bdun res dge 'dun re gso ba'i ’ srid byus lag bstar byas pas spyi tshogs 'gal ba sngar las che ru song ba ma zad bon po rnams la sngar bzhin nus pa yong pas

'gal ba sna tshogs gzhi gcig tu 'dres te dus rabs dgu ba'i dus 'gor chos snub pa'i las 'gul chen po byung ba red/ spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun pa nas dgu ba'i bar du sangs rgyas chos lugs gangs can ljongs su dar khyab dang 'phel rgyas byung ba'i dus rim 'di la lo rgyus thog tu ‘‘bstan pa snga dar ’’zhes 'bod/dus rabs bcu ba'i dus 'jug dang dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus 'gor slebs dus su sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan pa'i me ro slar yang mdo smad nas sos te mnga' ris sogs su rim gyis dar khyab byung bas 'di ‘‘bstan pa phyi dar ’’gyi rtags mtshon zhig yin/ sangs rgyas chos lugs bskyar dar byung bar sil bur 'thor ba'i sa gnas tshogs pa so so'i nus shugs kyi rogs skyor thob pa dang dus gcig tu sa gnas so sor chos lugs dar khyab byed pa'i sdom khrims dang rgyud pa la khyad par chen po yod par brten/dus rabs bco lnga bar slebs rags bar du rnying ma ba dang bka' gdams pa/ sa skya ba/ bka' brgyud pa/ dge lugs pa sogs bod kyi srid 'byor rig gsum la shugs rkyen rgya cher thebs pa'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi grub mtha' rnams 'phro rim 'phror mthud kyis byung /rnying ma ba ni nang ba'i grub mtha' khrod kyi byung ba

snga shos yin la rnying ma ba rnams kyis grub mtha' rang gi khyab spel byed bzhin pa'i bstan bcos rnams ni spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad par sangs rgyas chos lugs thu bhod du dar rgyas gtong bar byas rjes bla med bzhag pa'i 'phags yul gyi gsang sngags kyi slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas sku dngos kyis spel ba yin pa ma zad/slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas rnying ma'i grub mtha'i mes dbon chen po ru bkur ba red/ rnying ma bas btsan po'i dus skabs kyi ‘‘gsang sngags rnying ma ’dang btsan po'i dus skabs su bsgyur ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi gsang sngags gtso bo dar spel byed cing /gsang sngags kyi bstan bcos 'di dag btsan po'i dus skabs su dam chos ma snub pa'i gong du slob dpon pad ma sogs kyi gsang ba'i gter du sbas pas bstan pa phyi dar skabs su rim gyis gsar rnyed byung ba yin la de'i nang du 〈rdzogs pa chen mo〉ni bstan bcos gtso gras yin/ chos brgyud spel mkhan la rab du byung ba'i dge slong dang khyim pa dge bsnyen yod la dge slob dang khyim rgyud kyi 'brel pas chos brgyud mu mthud spel bzhin yod/ khong tsho'i dgongs par nges par du dam chos kyi gzhung lugs la 'chad nyan dang de thugs su chud dgos pa'i nges pa med par gtso bo rnal 'byor bas rtse gcig tu dka' spyad sgrub sbyangs byed rgyu

de yin zhing / bsod nams dang shes rab dbang du 'byor rgyu byed pa ni mi tshe'i dmigs yul yin pa 'a sa 'jig rten gyi khe dbang dang zing zing gi bde spyid 'dod pa ma yin no/ de'i phyir nang ba sangs rgyas/ pa'i chos lugs grub mtha' khag si khrod du gas nga sngags pa'i sgrub sbyangs dang chos gter 'don pa sna skad grags shin tu che ba yi na/7tre rmi snye skesteshas / ste rtsed+ku phu/ / r+shaci ci 4 ci mi sme ) snye sdusni rme churapu ngathorapa de3༄char bka' gdam pa'i bstan pa rnying ma ba dang bsdur na lhag par du mdo lugs kyi chos gzhung blo sbyong byed rgyu gal chen du 'dzin pa yin/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ( 1 0 0 5— 1 kya 6 zhu ) kyis/ gsar gtod mdzad cing grub mtha' 'di'i 'bo

dus rabs bcu ba'i mjug nas dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i stod kyi bstan pa phyi dar tshun la/bod du btab pa'i dgon pa mang che bas lte ba byas ba'i bzo kyi ma dpe bkol yod/ ga'is rka rtsere sa skya byang dgon dang sa skya lho dgon/ zhwa lu dgon/dpal chos dgon/ bkra shis lhun po/ lho ba'i gra thang dgon pa/ smin grol gling dang / r+ha sa'i dga' ldan dgon pa/ se ra dgon pa/ 'bras spungs dgon pa sogs skang grags che ba'i dgon chen gsum gyi khrod khyad chos 'di tshang ma rnyed thub nga yi/na/dgon pa'i bzo bkod 'de rigs khrod du lha zlang gco bo la tshogs chen 'du khang ngam dbu rtse 'du khang yod/snga rabs kyi lha khang gru ba'i dang bsdur na/ phyi rabs su phyogs yongs nas rgyas bskrun byas yod/ lhag par tu dus rabs bcu gsu ma pa nas 'bo brtsam sa te/bskor lam rnams phyi ru rgya bskyed pa/ zur khang dang sgo ra bzhengs srol rgya khyab tu byung ste tshogs chen 'du khang yang rim bzhin 'phel rgyas byung nas gru bci nar mo'i dbyibs ltar bzhengs mod/ dus rabs bco lnga ba'i mjug nas 'du khang be log gnyis rgyas bskrun byas te lha khang gi rnam pa ltar bzhengs srol byung / lha khang bod brgyud nang bstan pa'i chos lag so sor shugs cher 'gro ba dang / dge 'dun pa'i mi grangs nyin rer je mang du 'gro ba dang bstun nas snga rabs

kha3ri / /pa'i bsnyen bkur bya yul gyi sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen 'du khang de rim ba'in dase ri rdzi 'dun pa'i slob gnyer byed sa dang / tshogs 'tshog // nya ‘ sa/ sgrib sbyong byed ba'i gnas yul gal chen 'ig tu // gyur yod/ bzo bkod kyi phyi ngos la mdog skya ser // dang dkar po bsres sbyor yod pas bzo bkod gzab nan che zhing brjid nyams ldan pa'i rnam pa btod yod/ tho ri —dus rabs bcu gsum pa nas 'go brtsams te rgya bkras t+pa ma nga ma rgu sra nga lam phibs dang phyi rol gyi rgyan gtong stangs khrod du mes waṃtshorgyal nang khul bzo bkod kyi gzhu chen gzhu chung sogs khri kyi bzo stangs tshur len byas yod/ rgya phibs la ri ñcha dwags pho mo dang chos 'khor/ gdugs sogs kyis sdi brgyan nas spyi'i bzo bkod la brjid chags shing yid ky-iñcha du 'ong ba'i dpal gyis bltams yod/ grwa tshang dang snradagon pa'i do dam las khungs/ grwa shag/ mchod rten/ mkhar gyang sogs bzo bkod kyis tshogs chen 59'du khang gtso byas te phyi phyogs su rgya bskyed yod/ de las kyang dgon pa mang po zhig rir brten nas bzhengs yod pas bzo bkod legs la gong 'og gi bo rim gsal zhing spobs nyams kyi gzengs thog pa'i bzo bkod chen po zhig tu grub yod/brag phug dgon pa yang bod kyi dgon sde'i khrod rnam pa gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bzo bkod cig yin la/ rgya khyab du spyod pa'i dus yun thung zhing sa khongs cung

chung ba yin/ da lta bod kyi brag phug dgon pa'i sa khul gnyis yod pa de dag bstan pa snga dar dang phyi dar skabs su bsdus yod/ pho brang po ta la'i sgo nub phyogs kyi lcags po ri'i dgra lha klu phugre brag phug gi rnam pa ni ches snga shos yin/ da lta brag phug de'i bzo bkod brlag zin kyang brag phug da rung legs po yod/brag phug de nar mo'i dbyibs su grub cing phug sgo shar phyogs su gtad yod/ brag phug gi dbus su dbyibs gru bzhi ma'i dkyil du ka ba 'ig yod/dkyil dbus kyi ka ba'i phyogs ba'i la mchod gshom dang bskor ra byed sa'i skor lam rdog mo 'ig yod/phyi'i ldebs ngos kyi phyogs bzhi la mchod gshom sgrig pa/srong btsan sgam po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku 'dra yod/ brag phug de'i bzo dbyibs spyi ni skor lam nas dkyil kar skor ba byed chog pa yin/ dkyil ka'i phyogs ba'i la mchod gshom sgrig pa'i byed stangs ni nang logs 'i 'is khul du rgya khyab du spyod pa'i brag phug gi rnam pa dang ta cang 'dra bas brag phug mchod rten gyi dpe mtshon yin/dung dkar brag phug dang 'phel g.yang brag phug la dkyil ka med cing mchod gshom byed nga/ des dkyil ka'i tshab byed pa yin/ mdun ngos dang gyezhogs gnyis kyi ldebs ngos su 'jim sku dang lha sku bshams yod/ brag phug nang brkos ris cung nyung la ldebs

ris kyi ri mo mang po dkyil 'khor gyi ldebs ris sna tshogs yin/ brag phug 'di'i bzo stangs gtso bo bstan pa phyi dar skabs su byung yod/mchod rten gyi bzo bkod ni bod kyi dgon pa'i bzo bkod sgyu rtsal khrod ches ngo mtshar ldan pa 'ig yin/bod kyi dgon pa'i bzo bkod khrod du mchod rten dang sbrel ba'i bzo bkod mi 'dra sa ni bzo bkod kyi dpe dbyibs khrod/ mchod rten ni lha khang bzo bkod la gtogs pa'i bzo bkod rkyang ba zhig yin pa ma zad/dgon pa de'i bzo bkod yongs kyi lte ba'ang yin/mchod rten gyi bzo bkod gtso bo dus rabs bcu ba'i nas bco lnga'i bar bod kyi gtsang sa khul du khyab che/grags can gyi skor la ga'is ka rtse sa khul gyi jo nang mchod rten dang / ri bo che'i mchod rten dang rgyal rtse'i dpal mgon mchod rten/ rgyal rtse'i dpal chos dgon pa'i bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten sogs yin/de'i khrod dpal chos dgon pa'i bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten ni ha cang cha tshang yin pa ma zad dpe mtshon rang bzhin ldan pa yin/ dpal chos dgon pa'i bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten la thog brtsegs rim pa 1 2yod/ ngos gzhi dkyil 'khor la byas yod/bzo bkod kyi brtsegs rim dang po nas bcu gsum/ bar rdo skas dang mchod khang / bum pa sogs bang

rim bcu gsum ldan pa'i bzo bkod kyis grub yod/sa 'dzin bzo bkod dang bum pa'i bzo bkod kyi phyogs bzhi la lha khang bzhengs yod/ sa 'dzin bzo bkod la spyir brtsegs rim lnga yod la shar lho nub byang sogs phyogs bzhir che gcig chung gnyis kyi lha khang lnga byas pas lha khang bcu gnyis yod/ de'i brtsegs rim dang po nas gsum pa'i lha khang ha cang che la rtse mo thog brtsegs gnyis pa nas bzhi ba'i bar bsring yod/nyis thog dang bzhi thog la mchod khang bcu drug yod/nyis thog dang bzhi thog la mchod khang bcu drug yod/bum pa'i phyogs bzhi la mchod khang chen po re re bzhengs yod/ mchod rten 'di'i lha khang yongs su sgo 10ra'adug dngos su khyad sad byas pa'i lha khang 76gi brkos ris dang ldebs ris zung 'brel byas bas gser 'od 'phro bzhin yod/ brtsegs rim re re'i phyi'i bkod pa la rdo mkhar byas shing mchod rten gyi bzo stangs spyi babs gru bzhi dang sgor dbyibs byas yod/ gru bzhi'i bzo stangs la ngos bzhi zur drug can gyi rnam pa khyad mtshar ldan pas krung go'i sgyu rtsal khrod mang thob med pa'i sgyu rtsal 'ba' zhig tu chags yod/gsum/ pho brang gi bzo bkod/pho brang gi bzo bkod ni bod kyi bzo bkod khrod

lha khang dang dgon pa'i bzo bkod las ga.an da dung dran gso'i don snying ldan pa'i bzo bkod gal chen rdo ring lta bu cig kyang yin/ bod kyi pho brang bzo bkod 'di yang mkhar rdzong bzo bkod/ pho brang dang dgon pa'i baṭ+wāṃ bkod zung 'brel byas pa'i dus rim kha shas brgyud —da/ ci tsho4ri:muchi /sgyudzodzo ñca—dzori ci ne cisnye/rgyu/ ri rna snyo—cirdawamitsā snye chohūṃ ci ci ṭ+wāṃsnyeXri/ sīpye lkedzo ri2ci cici ra ri sadu ne+eri trī phro cho4 mi d+ku —tsho— snyermo kyi / kyi r+sha ———spre d+ngha——r+shargesprekhe—ske———ge zi sne skyi skyi nga tsho rngadara'esaseragyegyosnyephobasad lta bod ljongs lho kha sa khul sne gdong rdzong du 'gying nger 'grengs yod pa'i pho brang yum bu bla sgang rni bod kyi lo rgyus thog ches snga ba'i pho brang bzo bkod yin/ de ni bod rgyal thog ma gnya' khri btsan po'i skabs su bzhengs/ phal cher srid lo rtsis 'argo snga gzhug tu yin/ da yod kyi pho brang yum bla sgang rmi g.yang gzar gyi ri chung gcig gi steng 'gying nger langs yod la/ mtho tshad la smid 1 0lhag dang ga yo+o

med ker langs kyi rnam pa ha cang brjid nyams ྅ na pa yin/ bzo bkod spyi'i mkhar gyang rdo la byas bas sra/ mkhregs ldan zhing dus yun ha cang thub/ rtse thog sa shing las grub yod/ yum bu bla sgang gi snye zhol rni bde thang gzhong sa yin la bshad rgyun ni bod kyi zhing sa thog dang po yin par bshad/ spyi'i bzo bkod mtho zhing mar lta byas na phyogs bzhi mthong thub cing rdo skas brtsegs ma'i them pa brgyud de song tshe dpa' bo gcig gis btsan 'gag srung gyur na/ dpa' bo khri phrag gis kyang gtor bar dka' ba'i rnam pa 'ig tu grub yod pa ni gna' bo'i mkhar rdzong bzo bkod kyi bzo lta'i dpe mtshon yin la/ rgyal po'i dbang cha bla na ma mchis pa mtshon byed yang yin/spyi lo'i dus rabs bdun par/ srong btsan sgam pos mdo dbus mtho sgang gi ru ba so so gcig gyur byas nas btsan po'i rgyal rabs btsugs rjes/lo rgyus thog gzhi rgya che ba'i pho brang po ta la lha/ sar bzhengs pa yin/ de ni da lta skad grags che ba'i pho brang po ta la'i bzo bkod kyi 'byung khungs yin/yin na yang skad grags che ba'i bzo bkong 'di 1654lor gzhi khyon chen pos rgyas skrun byas la/gzhung yig tshad ldan thog nas deng snga'i bzo brkod kyi rnam pa phal che ba zhig mthong thub/ gna' bo'i pho brang po ta la'i bzo bkod kyis mkhar rdzong bzo bkod kyi khyad chos rgyun 'dzin byas yod de dmar po ri'i steng

btab nas srung sla 'ing rgol dka' ba'i khyad chos lnga na yod/ skabs der phyogs ba'i'i mkhar gyang 'a sto ba'i btod yod la mkhar sgo la rta babs btsugs yo+o nga pho brang ni dmar po ri'i steng yod la brtsegs rim dasdu lda na 'ing pho brang tshad med pa cig yo da/ ngag rgyun spyotā pho brang nang khang mig khakhakha yod/ rtse pho brang bsnan pas khang mig 1 0 rkya rkyayod/ de'i nang rgyal bo'i ngo brang dang btsun mo'i pho brang yod la/ rgyal bo'i ngo brang dang btsun mo'i pho brang bar dngul zam btsugs yod pa de phan tshun 'gro 'ong byed pa'i ched du yin/rtse pho brang gi klad du mtshon mdog lda na pa'i mda' mdung sogs dmag chas yo da la/ dar gos kyi ri0ma bu sna tshogs yang bkal yod/ shar sgo'i phyi rol gyi rtsa rtsal sbyong ba'i rwa skor chen po ni ched du btsan po'i rkyal rtsal 'don sa yin/tsho ci sgyu 73mestatshotsho tshotsha3 rti —ci—ru ju 4 ru skyisnye snazas spya ngas ngathor

mnga' ris sa khul spu hrengs rdzong sedzo ge kha 'bab lho rgyud kyi gu ge rgyal bo'i mkhar shul ni bod kyi pho brang bzo bkod khrod srung skyob cung legs pa'i gna' bo'i bzo bkod cig yin la/ cung cha tshang ba'i gna' bo'i pho brang bzo bkod kyi nyams 'gyur yang ldan pas bod kyi gna' bo'i pho brang bzo bkod khrod mtshon byed gal chen ldan pa yin/ da lta'e gu ge rgyal po'i pho brang bzo bkod kyi rgya khyon la smi gru bzhi ma khri tsho 1ṭ+wāṃyod/ spyi lo'i dus rabs 1 0pa'i mjug tu bzhengs 'go brtsams/ bzo bkod spyi rgyab rir bsten cing seng ge kha 'bab lho rgyud las smi 2 0 0lhag mtho ba'i sa ser ri bo'i steng btab yod/ spyi'i pho brang la rgyang blta byas na rdo skas brtsegs ma de rgyab rir bsten nas yar 'then cing / sra/ mkhregs ldan pa'i gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi rnam pa ltar grub pa brjid nyams ldan zhing yid du 'ong ba yin/ gu ge rgyal po'i gzim shag dang gros don pho brang gnyis gtor gzugs mchod rten gyi rtse mor bkod grod pa des nga che nga btsan gyi rgyal dbang phun sum tshogs pa ldan pa mtshon yod/ phyogs bzhir sa ser gyi mkhar gyang brtsigs shing sa babs gnyan sar btsan rdzong dang so kha btsugs yod/ da lta srung 'dzin cung legs pa'i lha khang dmar po dang lha lang dkar po'i

nang khul gyi bkod sgrig la bltas na/ pho brang dang dgon pa'i nang thog mar ka ba brtsengs nas ngor rgyog dang gdung ma 'phen pa/ gnam shing sogs bkab te ldebs ngos su ri mo 'bri ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ ston pa'i skyes rabs/ ston pa'i mdzad rnam sogs ldebs ris sna tshogs kyis brgyan par byas yod/ dro— cisde 4 ngesdo dze+egyo' rtse ngapawa ma thom rtsung rtsen gna' bo'i pho brang chen po 'di ni snga rabs kyi mkhar dang pho brang gi bzo bkod ltar srung sla zhing rgo' dka' ba'i khyad chos 'bur tu thon yod pa ma zad/gu ge rgyal pos 'go 'dzin dang rogs ram bgyis nas bod brgyud nang bstan 'phel rgyas su btang bas/bstan pa phyi dar la nang bstan slar gso byed pa'i bo rim khrod du dgon pa'i bzo bkod de pho brang bzo bkod kyi khongs su bcug pas bzo bkod kyi rnam pa

gsar ba zhig bskrun yod/ gu ge rgya'/ bo'i phu+ogs zhen gyi lta ba mched nas pho brang yu na ring bde ‘'god byed ched nang bstan chos lugs shar phyogs su brgyud bsgrags byas nas bod khul tu dar spe'/ du btang /lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi skabs su nang bstan chos lugs la rgyab skyor chen po byas nas grwa pa mang po phyi rgyal tu slob gnyer byed nga ra mngags/ dbon sde nas skyes chen bla ma gu ger gdan 'dren zhus nas 'chad khrid spel/ dbang sgyur 'a/ shugs snon byed ched ye shes 'od rab tu byung nas gnas de'i thog ma'i 'go 'dzin par gyur/ gu ge'i pho brang gi bzo stangs gnyis gcig sbyor byas pa'i nyams 'gyur des bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin zhing bran lam lugs de chos srid zung 'brel gyi lam nas rim ba'in mnga' ris sa khul la btsugs pa mtshon yo da/ chos lugs/ kyis lha'i nus pa bkol nas 'jig rten gyi srid dbang sra/ brtan gtong ba'i thabs shes de sgyu rtsal gyi/ lam nas mtshon par byas bas rjes su bod kyi bkas bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag so sor shan shugs zab cho/ ba'agyo yo da/dus rabs 1 2— 1 5bar bod kyi bkanu bkod rgyun 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag dper na/ sa skya chos rgyal phun tshogs pho brang / sgrol ma/ pho brang par+ṇa chen chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi bkra shes lhun po'i pho brang tā

la'i bla mas 'bras spungs dgon pa nas bzhengs pa'i dga' ldan pho brang sogs la bzo bkod 'di'i nyam sa 'gyur gyi shan zhugs yod/ bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi mnga' bdag ni spyir btang dbang 'dzin pa'i 'bo ba yin la/ chos lugs bdag po yang yin/ spyir sa skyong srid dbang dang chos lugs pa'i lha dbang gnyis gcig tu bsdus pa'i chos srid zung 'brel lam lugs rim bzhin 'thus tshang du btang ba dang bstun nas dgon pa'i bzo bkod yang dpal 'byor gyi rmang gzhi dang chab srid lam lugs dang bstun nas 'gyur ba byung ste 'os 'tsham ldan pa'i bzo bkod kyi rnam pa gsar ba thon yod la pho brang dang dgon pa'i bzo bko da zud 'brel— rjos ba'i bzo lta'ang mngon yod/—— da wa —sa tsho 101 bo'i10rte 3rngeri ngu rwa — — — — — — — —— —d+ngha — sacangabakra 3sa ther ngo snyengengathom

brgyad bcus brgyan yod/ byang chub sems dpa'i sku gzugs brjid nyams che la bag phab pa/ dar gos yang shing 'phyo ba/ phrag pa gnyis phyi ru mngon pa/dbu skra bsdams shing dbu rgyan mnabs pa/ sku la rin chen gyis rgyan gsol ba sogs ha cang yid du 'ong ba yin/ bod kyi lha bzo bas bod kyi srol rgyun sgyu rtsal dang nang bstan sgyu rtsal gnyis zung 'brel byed ci thub byed bzhin yod mod/ gang ltar sangs rgyas chos lugs ni phyi nas 'ongs pa'i rig gnas shig yin phyin/thog ma'i lag len khrod gzhan la lad mo mi byed thabs med yin/( 2 ) bod brgyud nang bstan gyi 'jim brkos sgru rtsal khron yongs nas dar rgyas chen po byung pa'i dus rabs/ (spyi lo'i dus rabs 1 2pa nas dus rabs 15pa'i mjug bar) /

( 4 ) bod brgyud nang bstan gyi 'jim bzo de rim gyis sna 'joms dang yid du 'ongs pa'i dus rabs shig tu 'phel ba/ ( dus rabs 16pa'i rjes nas) /dus rabs 16pa'i rjes la bod brgyud nang bstan pa'i 'jim brkos lhams 'gyur de rim gyis bris rgyun can dang / tshad thig can/ gsang pa'i nyams kyis phyug la/ rin po che'i phra rgyan gyis mdzes par spras pa sogs bzo rtsal shin tu mdzes shing / sku gzugs kyi rkos ris de las kyang zhib tshags ldan la rin po che'i rgyan gyis rgyan pa shin tu gal chen por brtsi/ gsang sngags kyi lha rnams de las kyang nang pa'i chos lugs kyi bsam blo mtshon pa'i khyad chos rtogs ka'i la nyams mtshar zhing / bzo dbyibs la srol rgyun gyi bkag rgya thebs pas 'gyur ldog chen po byung med/ dus rim 'di'i sangs rgyas kyi sku'i phra rgyan sgyu rtsal sngar las ldab 'gyur gyis 'phar la/ bla med kyi rgyas spras dang bzo rtsal zhib tshags ldan pa'i lag rtsal sogs ha las dgos pa'i tshad la slebs yod/'on kyang sgyu rtsal gyi khyon yongs nas bltas na/ dus rabs 1 2nas 15ba'i bar gyi gson nyams ldan la rang gi thun mong min pa'i khyad chos mi gsal bar gyur song / phun tshogs khyad chos ldan pa'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos mi nyung pa zhig yod mod/ 'on kyang khyon yongs nas dar rgyas byung pa'i dus skabs dang

bsdur thabs bral/bod brgyud nang bstan 'jim rkos la rigs ha cang mang / rgyu cha yang gser dang / dngul/zangs/ gser bsres ma sogs gser rigs kyi bzo sku mang zhing / de dang dus mtshungs su 'bag sku dang /shing brkos/ rdo brkos/ me tog mchod pa sogs zlum brkos dang / 'bur brkos/ thig brkos sogs brtsams chos shin tu mang po byung yod/ de khrod kyi 'bag sku dang / li ma/ rdo brkos sogs rgyun tu mthong la brtsams chos yang ches mang pas bod brgyud nang bstan gyi bzo rkos kyi ma lag gtso bor gyur yod/gnyis pa/ lcags rigs bzo brkos kyi brtsams chos/lcags rigs kyi bzo brkos mang che ba blugs ma/ yin la/ brtsams chos la la sku gzugs hril bor blugs ma yin la/ la la sku lus kyi cha shas blugs ma yin/ dus rabs khapa'i dus dkyil du bstan pa bsnubs pa dang / rang byung gnod 'tshe sna tshogs dang zing 'khrugs sogs kyi dbang gis bod btsan po'i dus rabs kyi lcags rigs bzo sku mang che ba brlags zin pa red/ da lta nyar tshags byas yod pa'i lcags rigs bzo sku mang che ba bstan pa phyi dar skabs kyi brtsams chos red/ da lta yod pa'i bzo sku'i brtsams chos kha shas phyi gling ba'i lag tu shor nas

nub phyogs rgyal khab kyi dngos mang bshams ston khang dang sger gyis nyar tshags byas yod/ brtsams chos kha shas shig bod kyi dgon sde khag na nyar tshags byas yod de/ ra mo che gtsug lag khang dang / sa skya dgon pa/ zha lu dgon pa/ po ta la/ nor bu gling ga pe cing pho brang rnying ma'i dngos mang bshams ston khang du cung mang po nyar tshags byas yod/dus rabs snga ma'i lcags rigs bzo sku'i nang du kha shas shig sangs rgyas chos lugs bod du dar ba dang bstun nas phyi logs nas bod du gdan drangs 'ongs pa yin la/ de dag ni dus rabs de'i bod kyi lha bzo rnams kyi bzo sku'i ma dper gyur cing / ga'an dag ni dus rabs snga ma'i bod kyi sgyu rtsal pa rnams kyi bzo stangs la dpe bltas nas bzos pa'i bod rang gi brtsams chos yin/srol rgyun ltar na/ bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis bod btsan po'i dus nas bzung phyi nas bod du gdan drangs pa'i nang pa'i lha sku rnams rgya gar dang /rgya nag hor te bzo bkod mi 'dra ba rigs gsum du phyes yod/rgya gar gyi lha sku rnams rgya gar dbus ma dang /— dzo shar ma/ lho ma/ nub ma/ byang ma ste sa khul rigs lnga ru phyes yod/ rgya gar dbus ma'i lha sku mang tsho che ba li sku dkar po dang / khra bo/ dmar po yin — la/ sku lus ni li dkar dang chos gos zangs kyis gser gyi pad sdong /

bzos pa/ zangs thang ma'i lugs kyi bzo sku sku lus khyon yongs kyi sdur tshad mnyam la zhal ras mdzes pa/sku gzugs phra la dbu rgyan drang pa/ shangs mthong la zhal drang thig gcig gi steng du yod pa/ spyan dbrag dog la kha sha tshad dang ldan pa/ na bza' sku la 'tsham zhing ri mo gsal ba zhig yin/ ston pa'i sku la skabs 'gar lteb chag phra mo'i phyi lwa mnabs pa'ang yod/bzhugs khri phal cher rdo rje dang / seng ge pad+ma ma'i rgyan gyis rgyan pa'i bzhugs khri mang la/ pad+ma'i 'dab ma rim par brtsegs la/ bzhugs khri'i gong 'og tu rin po che'i phra yis brgyan nas shin tu mdzes shing yid du 'ong pa zhig yin/ byang sems rnams kyi gzugs byad lhod du chags shing / gtsug tor mtho ba/ rin po ches rgyan yod/ de las kyang phul tu byung ba'i brtsams chos gser sbyang btso ma'i sku dang gser bsregs ma srab thug gang rung gis bzos pa'i sku rnams kyang yod/ rgya gar shar ma'i lha sku rnams li ma dkar po'i sku sha yin/ lhad med la rgyan cha mang ba/kha yi dbyibs legs la spyan dbrag thung ba/ gdong pa leb cing mtho ba/ rgya gar dbus ma'i bzo stangs dang bsdur na cung zad khong du rdib pa'i snang ba ster/sku gzugs ring la mdzes nyams rgyas pa/ bzo lta bab chags pa/ phyag rkang mnyam la zhal ras ring pa/phyag mdzub zlum la dbu rgyan phyi ru dgyes pa/ na bza' lteb rtsegs mang la sku lus khebs pa zhig yin/

bzhugs khri rgya gar shar ma'i bzo stangs dang 'dra/de yang pad ma'i 'dab ma nyis brtsegs can cung dma' tsam yod/ rgya gar nub ma'i lha sku rnams li dkar dang zangs kyis bzos shing / zhal dbyibs ring la spyan dbrag thung ba/ rgyun par spyan zangs dngul gyis bzo ba/ gdong ba sbom la ril ba/ kha sha cung thug la ran pa/ bzo lta bab chags kyang de 'dra yid du mi 'ongs pa/ sug bzhi cung thung / na bza' lteb brtsegs ring zhing sku lus yongs su btum pa/ dbu la rgyan dang rin po che'i phra dang me tog gang mang gis brgyan zhing / pad ma'i bzhugs khri sna tshogs pa yod/ rgya gar lho ma'i lha sku zangs kyis bzo ba/ zhal dbyibs thung la zlum pa/ sku sha lhod pa/spyan dbrag yangs pa/ sna leb la thod pa'i rgya chung ba/sku gzugs bzo lta mdzes shing sku lus yongs la phra rgyan btang shing ri mo med pa/ bzhugs khri pad 'dab yangs la 'dab ma ma 'dres pa/ mgo cung zad nang du gug cing ri mo ser po kha gyes pa dang mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i me tog gi brkos brgyab pa/ pad ma la la kha zum pa dang gser gyis spras pas mdog ha cang mdzes/ rgya gar byang ma'i lha sku rnams li dkar dang zags kyis bzos shing / zhal ras ring la sgong ba'i

gzugs/ spyan che la sna ring ba/ gdong ba cung zad zlum pa/ sku gzugs kyi sdur tshad cha snyoms pa/sug bzhi mnyen lcug pa/ bzo lta bab chags kyang mdzes nyams chen po med pa/ phra rgyan gyis sku lus gang ba/skabs 'gar pad ma sngon pos phyag gdub rgyan pa/ gos kyi ri mo zhib tshags ldan la mig dang kha sha dngul dang zangs kyis rgyu byas pa/ bzhugs khri'i steng gi pad ma kha ma gas pa/ gzhung rta phra la lo ma che ba/ mar gug pa/ dbyibs gru bzhi dang / zlum po/ da dung gzhan dag kyang yod/ bzhugs khri'i steng gi khri'i rgyab yol nag po can/ rigs mi mthun pa 'di lnga po rim gyis gzhan pa'i khyad chos mang por 'phelabazhin yod/ tshogyildopo ca lar bhezu0sa pa'i gser gyi sku 'dra

krung go'i nang logs kyi lcags rigs bzo brkos la thang rgyal rabs dang ming rgyal rabs kyi sku 'dra ste rigs gnyis su phyes yod/ thang rgyal rabs kyi sku 'dra nyams chung zhing / sna che ba/ 'al ras gtsang la rid pa/ kha sha rgyas pa/ zhal dbyibs cung zad ring pa/ mig chung ba/ chos gos dang sku ber khod che zhing yangs pa/ lwa ba'i bzo stangs 'grig pa/ rgyan cha shin tu mang pos sku la spras/ sku gzugs ran la lag pa chung ba phyag mdzub phra la ring ba zhig yin/ sku 'dra 'ga' re gong gi bzo lta bzhin bzos pa'ang yod/ ming rgyal rabs kyi sku 'dra blugs ma gtsang zhing dri ma med la/ mdzes shing 'og 'tsher ba/ gser chu'i sgyu rtsal bla na 'phags shing sku gzugs rgyas pa/ chos gos dang gzan ris mdzes shing ngo cung leb pa/ mig zung phra la ring ba/ pad khri nyis brtsegs ldan pa/ pad khri'i mtha' yongs su bskor zhing gos 'dabs kyi rtse rnams phra la rno/ pad khri'i gong 'og gnyis su lta na sdug pa'i rin po che'i phra mang pos brgyan cing / phra rgyan gyi bar thag mnyam la gral 'grig po yod/ khri dang khri zhabs gnyis yugs gcig tu 'brel pas brtan cing rdo rje rgya gram gyis dpal gtams shing spyin chu dkar po zhugs yod/thang rgyal rabs kyi sku 'dra dang bsdur na cung zhib

tshags yin/ de min rdo rje'i rgya gram gyi steng du ri mo dang yi ge gang yang brkos med/ sangs rgyas kyi sku la dad pa'i ched du yin zhes bshad srol yod/ rgya'i li dang li mdog dkyus ma dang / de min ngos 'dzin sla ba'i rgyu chas blugs pa yang mang po yod/hor sku blugs ma ni stod hor dang smad hor gnyis su phyes yod/ hor gyi bzo sku ni 'al ras gor ——la thung ba/ chos gos sku la gsol zhing / gos —d+me/'dabs phra la ring pa/ lta na sdug pa'i dbu skra chu yi dūsmiganyer ma dang 'dra ba zhig yin/ pad ma'i 'dab rnyi mar lteb ris yod la gong 'og kun tu yal 'dab bris snra yod/ pad ma'i gzhung rta phra la ring zhing 'od ldan pa/ waṃ lo 'dabs stong pa yin/ bzhugs khri 'brug gis rnyi btegs yod la gser chu byugs med la shing rtsi dang —snum gyis byugs pa sogs yin/ 01bod brgyud nang bstan gyi sku 'drar rang gi srol rgyun gyi khyad chos rgyud 'dzin gyi steng du gong gsal 'dra sku'i sgyu rtsal rnams bsdu len byas pas bod rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i 'dra sku'i srol rgyun zhig chags yod/ bod btsan po'i dus nas bzung mi lo chig stong sum tshobargya lhag gi ring la lag len dang gsar gtod brgyud pe’/ — —nas gsham gyi bzo rgyun khyad chos mi 'dra ba dgu ru ñca snan zlacus khang du bzusas pa'i jo bo gyes yod de/ rir po che

gser/ dngul dang gser/ zangs ma dang gser sbyong ba sogs gzhan pa'i lcags rigs brgyad dang gser mnyam du sbyang nas blugs pa'i rgyu spus legs la bzo rtsal phul du phyin pas/ skabs de'i rgya gar gyi lha ciridhe sku dang dbye 'byed dka' ba'i gnas zhig chags yod/— ṅgechu dza ( 5 )le wo byams pa'i lha sku li ma zhes pa ni lha riṅka sna ri bzo mkhas pa le wo byams pas bzos pa'i lha sku li ma yum bu bla mkhar nang bra 'jim bsnyan rnams yin/ 'di'i rigs ni ming rgyal rabs skabs kyi rgyal nang gi lha sku'i khyad chos ldan/ nyams 'gyur yung le gong ma'i skabs kyi lha sku li ma dang shin tu mthun/ bzo bkod shin tu mdzes shing skyil krung gi rnam pa bag phab cing bde ba/ pad ma nyis brtsegs kyis bzhugs khri'imatha' a long gi gzugs su bskor zhing / pad 'dabs ri mo gsal la go rim dam pa zhig yin/(3 rili rurteci wanyalha //spi ’ k+ṣ-i7 sri)༵/ // hūṃ tsho rī ju‘ skyinidi tsho(( mi rī du/ dh+ra lhornoci ) sh+laurinyu stodzi chi skyi rmo tsho ri d+ku—1d+ngha trī rijuri—r+shalkuX /trirka rme ma slo/trī so — k+ṣ-i ’ rte risna ji — / 944ne she ra ne 7ri sna 3 rngi—rī༄ sdeX d+kuske ༷ ji dzormecha thababasgyu /) /sku /ra55/ sto ci

gsum pa/ 'jim sku'i brtsams chos kyi skor/lcags rigs kyi lha sku dang bsdur na/ 'jim sku'i rgyu cha 'byung khungs cung zad mod pas bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dgon pa'i lha sku'i nang du 'jim sku dar khyab shin tu che/ 'on kyang 'jim sku rnams zhig sla bas dus rabs sngon ma'i lha sku mang po nyar tshags byed thub med/ de la yang 'jim sku dang tshwa tshwa ste rigs gnyis su phyes yod/ 'jim sku ni lha sku chen por bzhengs yod la spyir btang skya bzo dang tshon ldan gnyis su phyes la/ da lta nyar tshags byas yod pa'i lha sku mang che ba tshon ldan nam gser byugs pa'i lha sku rigs yin/ der brten/ tshon ldan 'jim sku ni 'jim sku'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos khrod gnas babs gal chen bzung yod/ spyir btang gis bshad na/'jim sku'i rus sgrom ni dus rgyun tu shing dang ko ba/rtswa sogs kyis byed la/ gzhung shing tshang ma shing gis byed/ nyams 'gyur skabs de'i lha sku blugs ma'i khyad chos dang khyad par cher med/ tshwa tshwa de dkyus ma'i 'jim sku dang bsdur na/ gzugs chung la jipyo thabs rtsal mi 'dra bas tshang ma dpar kong du dpar ba tre gidze rkyang rkyang red/ mnga' ris sa khul gyi thog gling dgon pa'i 'jim sku ni dbus gtsang du nyar tshags bkras trin jaman gyi khe hre me aralur chos ldan pa'i rti sku/

byas yod pa'i 'jim sku'i khrod kyi ches snga ba'i gras red/da lta nyar yod pa dang nye ba'i lo shas bton pa'i brtsams chos thog nas bltas na/ mnga' ris sa khul dang / la dwags khul gyi a chig dgon sogs kyi lha sku'i khyad chos gcig mtshungs red/ brtsams chos kyi brjod bya shin tu phun sum tshogs po yod cing /gtso bo de bzhin bshegs pa'i sku dang / byang chub sems dpa'/ rjes 'jug slob ma/ mkhas mdzangs kyi skyes bu dam pa dang / grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po/ chos skyong srung ma sogs kyi sku gzugs su 'du/ de'i nang nas gtso sku tshang ma shin tu chen por bzhengs shing / mtho tshad smid bcu phrag tsam bzhengs yod la sku 'khor yang rgyun ldan mi tshad tsam re yod/ khe hri me 'ar gyi nang pa'i sgyu rtsal gyi nyams 'gyur thon yod/ sku 'dra'i bsdur tshang mthun spyor yin pas rkang lag mnyam pa/ sna'i gzengs mtho zhing phrag pa yangs pa/ brtan cing lhun chags pa zhig yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sku ni phra la ldem pa/nu ma rgyas shing rked pa phra ba/ skye gzugs mdzes pa yi nyams dang ldan/ bzo dbyibs mdzes shing sna tshogs pa/ de bzhin bshegs pa'i sku dang bsdur na/sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa zhig yin/ rjes 'jug slob ma'i sku dang / mkhas mdzangs kyi skyes bu dam pa/

grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po sogs kyi sku gzugs mi sna dngos kyi khyad chos ngo ma ji bzhin bris yod/ chos skyong srung ma'i sku gzugs rgyun lda na gyi lha sku'i tshad las ches cher brgal zhing / 'char yan gyi bsam blo'i khyad chos shin tu phun sum tshogs pas kun nas phyugabartsams chos 'di dag mang che ba tshon dang bris ma zung du 'brel nas bzos sku dang bris sku gnyis gzhi gcig tu sbrel pa'i sgyu rtsal zhig yin/ dbu dang / sku lus/yan lag dang don lnga sogs bzos pa dang / rgyan gos dang lus kyi cha shas 'ga' re ri mo'i sgyu rtsal bed spyad nas bris pa 'ig yin/ dper na/ a chig dgon du nyar tshags byas pa'i brtsams chos kha shas kyi rkang pa'i steng du lo rgyus byung rim sogs bris yod la/mi'i gzugs brnyan gson nyams ldan la phra zhing zhib pas khyad du 'phags pa'i ri mo'i bris rtsal mthong thub/bris sku dang 'jim sku zung du 'brel ba'i bzo stangs 'di stod mnga' ris sa khul du bstan pa phyi dar gyi ) dus 'gor 'jim sku gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos skeri cig yin// gzhis ka rtse'i sa khul gyi e waṃ dgon gyi 'jim sku // ni da lta dbus gtsang sa khul du nyar tshags ches snga ri/ ba'i 'jim bzos sgyu rtsal gyi ya gyal zhig yin la/ e snyusru snye waṃ dgon pa'i 'jim sku'i bzo dbyibs ha cang mdzes tshacas

shing / bzo rtsal zhib tshags ldan pa/ de yang bod kyi gna' bo'i 'jim sku'i sgyu rtsal khrod ha cang rtsa che ba'i brtsams chos shig yin/ e waṃ dgon pa dus rabs 1 2pa'i nang btab la/ gro mo dang rgyal rtse gnyis kyi tshong lam gtso bo'i 'brel lam du yod/dgon pa der 'od dpag med kyi lha khang dang / mi bskyod rdo rje'i lha khang / mgon khang sogs gsum gyis grub/ dgon pa'i sgo chen lho ru'akhor zhing /phyi'i mtha' bskor du ma ṇi'i bar khyams kyis bskor yod/ lha khang gtso bo dgon pa'i byang zur du yod la/gtso sku rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyan chen po zhig bzhengs yod/ rgyal ba mi bskyod rdo rje'i ga yas g.yon du rje btsun byams pa mgon po sogs 'khor dag pa rnam brgyad kyis bskor la/ logs gnyis su sku 'khor gsum re'i sku brnyan bzhengs 'dug de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku dang byang chub sems pa'i sku tshang mas chos gos gsol yod pa mthug zhing lteb brtsegs kyi ri mo mang po ldan/ lha khang du deng thog de bzhin bshegs pa'i sku brnyan drug tsam yod kyang phal cher ba zhig chags skyon shor yod/ lha khang gtso bo'i g.yas zur du mgon khang yin la bdud tshogs kyis shākya mu ne dpung 'jug byed pa'i 'jim sku yod kyang da lta zhig nas lha khang stong bar lus yod/ e waṃ dgon

gyi 'jim sku rnams mi tshad las mtho zhing zhal ras la gser thug po byugs yod/ lha khang gi klad brdibs cing lha sku rnams dus yun ring por phyi ru bud pas gser med par chags yod/ nyams 'gyur gyi thog nas bltas na/ e waṃ dgon gyi lha sku rnams ni rgya gar po lo sgyu rtsal dang dbus rgyud nang bstan gyi sgyu rtsal gnyis zung du 'brel ba'i thon rdzas yin/ lha sku'i spyan dkyus ring zhing mthug pa/ dpral ba'i dbyes che zhing 'bur ba/ brang zheng che zhing sna chung ba/sna'i bu ga gsal ba/ kha sha'i ri mo 'khyog cing /gtsug tor gyen du mtho la che ba/ lag mthil mthug cing phyag mdzub 'khyog la ring ba/ rgya gar po lo sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos 'bur du thon yod/ de dang mnyam du/ mi'i bzo stangs yongs dang lhag par du rjes 'jug slob ma rnams kyi bzo dbyibs rang rgyal nub byang gi grangs nyung mi rigs kyi rnam pa 'dra ba'i khyad chos mngon par gsal/ bong che chung dang lji tshad gal chen por brtsi/ dbu rgyan zur gsum ma'i dbyibs de min la/ bzo lugs je cher btang ste shing gi lo ma'i dbyibs dang nye ba ltar bzos yod/mtho zhing drang pa'i smin ma rgya gar po lo sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ltar 'khyog pa'i dbyibs su bris pa zhig min/ma ne gru bzhi'i dbyibs dang / dbu skra dang phra zhing rtse

rno ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba sogs e sha ya dbus rgyud kyi tshad mtho'i sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos shugs chen po mngon 'dug— tre ri k+ko'isngatrī 4ོtsha rji bye~X po nga spang bhezusas nga 'e 'jim khod che la mthug cing lce ba'i chos gos ni e waṃ dgon pa'i 'dra sku'i ches 'bur thon gyi khyad chos gtso bo yin/ chos gos mar dpyang zhing gos kyi lteb brtsegs zhib pa/ thig skud drang ba/ brtsams chos la la'i nang rkang pa'i phyi rting bar dpyang ba'ang yod/de ma zad chos gos kyi steng du mdzes shing lta na sdug pa'i me tog gi tshom bus spras shing / rgyal nang gi bzo sku'i chos gos bzo stangs dang shin tu nye/ 'di lta bu'i chos gos kyi bzo stangs dang gos kyi lteb chag nang nas stag gzig gi khyad chos ldan pa'i 'khyug ris sogs skabs de'i dgon pa'i 'jim brkos khrod dar khyab shin tu che/ rig dngos kun gsog dang /

rme spyo snyigs dor bcud len ni e waṃ dgon gyi 'jim sku'i khyad chos gtso bo yin la/ de dang dus mtshungs su bod brgyud nang bstan spyi'i 'jim brkos dang bod brgyud nang bstan sgyu rtsal spyi'i khyad chos chen po shig be+ed kyi lha bzo'i sgyu rtsal ba/ yin/ nyams 'gyur mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bsdu len dang snyigs dor bcud len brgyud nang bstan sgyu rtsal da spyi'i khyad chos ched po shig yin/ nyams 'gyur mi 'dra ba sna tshogs bsdu len dang snyigs dor bcud len brgyud nas rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos shig tsho chags yod/ skad grags ldan pa'i rgyal rtse'i dpa' two chos dgon gyi bzo sku ni rigs 'di'i mtshon byed gtso waṃ smi bo yin/ske rgyal rtse'i dpal chos dgon ni 1427lo nas 1426lo'i bar btab la/ bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten dang dgon pa gnyis kyis grub pa yin/ dgon /2 pa 'dir thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo mang mchod rten dang snyan grags 'dzam gling du khyab pa'i ldebs ris yod pa ma zad gson nyams ldan pa'i 'jim sku de dag gis snyan pa'i grags pa phyogs mtshams kun tu rgyas pa red/dpal chos dgon pa'i sku mang che ba tshon sku yin la bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten gyi lha khang bdun cu don drug dang thog brtsegs gsum can gyi tshogs chen 'du khang sogs su bzhugs yod/ grangs shin tu mang /bkra shis sgo mang mchod rten du bzhugs pa'i tshon sku

rnams gsang sngags kyi bya rgyud dang / spyod rgyud/rnal 'byor rgyud/ rnal 'byor bla med rgyud sogs kyi phyag len ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i sku brnyan gyis grub yod/ brjod bya shin tu phun sum tshogs pas phal cher bod brgyud nang bstan pa'i mardo sngags las gsungs pa'i lha tshang ma dang / lo rgyus khrod byon pa'i skyes bu dam pa mang che ba'i sku brnyan bzhengs yod/ der brten bod brgyud nang bstan khri sku'i lha khang zhes pa'i mtshan snyan 'bar/ tshon ldan brtsams chos 'di ga'i khrod dus rabs snga ma'i phyi phyogs sgyu rtsal gyi shan shugs chen po thebs pa de mthong rgyu med/ phyi phyogs sgyu rtsal gyi ming brda dang rgyu rkyen tshang ma khyon yongs nas sa gnas kyi khyad chos dang 'dres nas/ snga na med pa'i khyad chos gsar ba dang bzo stangs gsar ba zhig byung nas/ bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzes dpyod kyi lta ba dang rin thang gi lta ba zhig mngon yod pa red/ thog brtsegs gsum can gyi tshogs chen 'du khang chen mo'i nyis thog lam 'bras lha khang gi grub chen dang sa skya'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ gnas brtan bcu drug gi 'dra sku ni ches phul du byung ba'i bzo sku yin/ dge ba'i bathes gnyen dang grub chen/ gnas brtan 'di dag si 'dra sku cha tshang shin tu mnyam zhing / sku gzugs rgyas pa brjid pa'i nyams dang ldan/ zhal gyi nyams

'gyur phun sum tshogs la chos gos kyi lteb brtsegs ri mo 'khyil zhing rang byung gi nyams dang ldan pa/ snyan 'jebs dbyangs kyi 'gyur khug ltar yid du 'ongs shing / bab chags la dngos don dang mthun pa/phul du phyin pa'i rang byung ring lugs kyi 'dra sku'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos zhes bsngags 'os pa zhig yin/dus rabs snga ma'i sgyu rtsal brtsams chos dang bsdur na/mi 'dra ba'i khyad chos gtso bo ni sngon ma ltar phyi'i rnam pa'i mdzes sdug gi bzo bkod la 'bad pa tsam ma yin par/ phyi'i nyams 'gyur la brten nas thun mong ma yin pa'i nang sems kyi 'gyur ba mtshon thub pa byas nas/ bzo dbyibs cha tshang shing gson nyams ldan pa sogs bod kyi bzo sku'i sgyu rtsal bas mi'i 'dra sku gsar gtod khrod nas sgyu rtsal gyi 'bras bu 'bur du thon pa blangs ba mtshon thub/dpal chos dgon pa'i ldebs ris ltar na bzo ji sku tshang ma bod rang gi lha bzo bas bzos pa yin la/kausgecici per+ṣa7 lha ris pa 'di dag gtsang gi dar sna dang / jo nang /cispyarici rme 8 rgyal rtse/ sne gdong / lha sa'i snye mo sogs nas rdzi rngo)’ lotredrosi 'ongs pa yin/ dpal chos dgon du dus rabs rjor+sha4 na sko 7//ritsā ṭā bco lnga ba'i bod kyi lha bzo mkhas pa rnams 'dus yod ri —rin cibyubyerme la/ lha bzo ba 'di dag gis rang rang gi sa gnas kyi rdzo ༷snang /chi4stsa thun mong ma yin pa'i lag rtsal khyer nas gnas 'dir /zla nya— trīljashā 'dus nas/ phan tshun slob sbyong dang dpyad gzhir bka' brgyud pa'i sku 'dra/da lta'i b.radu lo ngo 4ci lhag gi lo rgyusayod pa red/

kyi rdo brkos yin/ de yang lho kha 'phyongs rgyas kyi btsan po'i bang so'i mdun gyi rdo seng ge dang / chab mdo'i bstan ma brag dang mtsho sngon yul shul sa cha'i rgya bza' kong jo'i lha khang gi kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku sogs 'bur brkos mthon po skad grags shin tu che/ btsan po'i bang sor da lta rdo brkos kyi seng ge gnyis nyar yod de/ btsan po khri lde srong batren gyi bang so'i mdun du yod la/ gcig la chag skyon shor 'dug chag skyon med pa'i rdo seng ge'i mtho tshad la smi 145yod la/ rdo hril bo gcig brkos nas grub pa yin/ rdo seng ge tsog 'dug byas yod la sug bzhi sbom la thung ba/ sra la stobs che ba/stegs khri'i steng du 'gyengs nger langs yod/ mgo bo dgyes shing kha cung zad gdangs ba/ mig zung rno zhing g.yu ral ltag rgyab tu 'phyo ba brag ri'i ngos nas 'bab chu 'pho ba dang 'dra/ brtsams chos hril bo brkos rtsal zhib cing gtsang pa/ snying bcud 'dus shing che brkos gtsigs su bzung pa sogs gzugs ga'i log log po lta bu zhig gi snang pa ster pa dang /gzi rngam che la 'jigs med snying stobs 'gran zla bral ba sogs gzhan dang mi 'dra bas rdo bzo mkhas pa'i lag rtsal de mthong thub/ bstan ma brag dang rgya bza' kong jo'i lha khang gi rdo brkos kyi nang don 'dra ste/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi 'khor du kun

tu bzang po dang / 'jam dbyangs/ phyag rdor/sgrib pa rnam sel/ nam mkha'i snying po/ thugs rje chen po/ byams pa/ sa yi snying po sogs byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi 'khor gyis bskor/ kun rig rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor gyi byang sems 'di dag bod btsan po'i skabs su dar khyab shin tu che/ngag rgyun ltar na/ rdo brkos 'di gnyis rgya bza' kong jo bod du phebs pa'i lam du khong gis rgya nag nas 'khrid 'ongs pa'i lha bzo ba rnams la 'al bkod bzhag nas brkos pa yin zhes bshad srol yod/ rdo sku'i sku tshad shin tu mtho la che ste/ gtso sku kun rig rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku tshad la smi 7 2yod 'a//'khor gyi byang sems kyi sku'i mtho tshad la smi 4yod la tshang ma'i steng du gser byugs yod/ gser shin tu mthug po byugs yod kyang bzhin sha dod pa'i 'gram pa gnyis dang / rgyas pa'i gzugs dbyibs dang lha sku'i nyams sogs gsal bor mthong thub/ bstan ma brag gi rdo brkos rnams rgya bza' kong jo'i lha khang si rdo sku dang phal cher 'dra la thang rgyal rabs dbus rgyud nang logs gi rdo brkos dang 'brel ba zab mo yo da kyang / mi 'dra sa ni de la lo rgyus kyi dus tshigs gsal bo yod pas/ lo rgyus kyi rin thang gal chen ngo yod/

rgyal rtsedapal chosadabon du bzhugs pa'i 'jim brnyan/brag khung gi rdo sku bod du mang po mthong rgyu med/lha sa'i khra lag lam phu ni bod kyi brag khung rdo brkos nyar tshags byas yod pa'i gnas gcig red/ brag khung gi dgon pa de bod btsan po'i skabs su btab pa zhig yin mod/ de'i nang gi lha sku rnams dus de nas bzung rim gyis brkos nas grub pa 'ig yin/ lha sku rnams gtso bo dkyil gyi ka ba'i phyogs bzhi dang brag ngos kyi them khung du bzhugs yod/ 'dra sku gtso bo sangs rgyas dang byang sems/ skyes thob kyi bla ma sogs chos phyogs kyi 'dra sku dang / btsan po dang blon chen sogs kyi sku rnams bzhugs yod/ rjes ma ni chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang / bal bza' khri

16pa'i nang gi sman thang lugs kyi mdzes ris pa grags can zhig yin pa ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis pa dang gsum pa gnyis kyi thugs su btags yod la/ spyi lo 1526lor chos 'khor rgyas dgon pa'i tshogs chen gyi ldebs ris legs grub byung ste mtshan la'ang lha bzo'i rgyal po zhes gsol/ gzhan du sku nyid ni snyan ngag pa zhig yin pa ma zad/ sgyu rtsal gzhung lugs smra ba zhig kyang yin no/ 'dan ma sangs rgyas lha dbang ni dus rabs 16pa'i nang la snyan pa 'phur ba'i sgyu rtsal mkhas chen zhig yin pa dang / bris rgyun gzhan pa dag gi khyad chos la dbang 'byor yod pa zhig kyang red/ rnam dkar ma'i dgon dang sa dkar gyi ldebs ris dag ni khong gi mtshon byed brtsams chos gtso bo'o/ 'brug chen pad ma dkar po ( 1527—1592 ) ni gzhung lugs brtsams chos ha cang mang ba zhig yin la/ 'bri rtsal la nang byan chub pa'i sman thang lugs kyi mdzes ris mkhan po zhig kyang yin/ khong gi brtsams chos 〈li sku'i gzigs dpyad〉ni mdzes ris kyi rig gzhung smra ba'i khrod du ha cang grags che ba zhig go sman thang lugs kyi mdzes ris pa de dag gis mdzes ris sgyu rtsal gyi gzhung lugs dang lag len khrod du lag rjes rmad du byung ba bzhag pa des lugs 'di'i snyan grags dgung

dang sman thang lugs gnyis 'dra bar mes rgyal nang logs kyi mdzes ris kyi khyad chos dod la/ mi 'dra sa ni gna' gzhung sman thang ri mo'i lugs dang bsdur tshe/mkhyen brtse lugs kyi tshon mdog cung stug la/ de dang mtshungs par lugs 'di sa skya ba dang 'brel 'dris zab mo yod cing / gsang sngags khrod kyi byang chub sems dpa' brjod bya byas te ri mo 'bri pa la mkhas pas ming du grags pa yin no/lugs 'di srol btod mkhan mkhyen brtse chen mo ni lho brag gong dkar sgang stod du 'khrungs la/sman bla don grub dang dus skabs gcig gi mi yin/khong gnyis kyi rdo ba bkra shis rgyal bo bla mar bsten nas ri mor slob sbyong byas myong / gong dkar rdo rje bstan pa kun dga' rnam rgyal ( 1422—14kha6)gyis phyag btab pa'i gong dkar dgon gyi ri mo dag ni khong gi brtsams chos ming grags can yin/ dgon pa'i nang gi sdebs ris mang che ba khong gi smyug rtse las thon zhing / de dag las kyang 'du khang chen mo'i phyi ldebs kyi 〈dpag bsam ljon bzang 〉mtshon byed kyi gtam rgyud dang thog khang gyes rdor khang gi rnal 'byor rgyud sde bzhi'i khrod kyi byang chub sems dpa'i ldebs ris de dus rabs 2 0ba'i lo rabs 60ba'i bar du ma nyams par gnas yod/ mkhyen brtse chen mo ni sgyu rtsal gyi brtsams chos shin tu mang ba'i mdzes ris pa zhig yin/ gong dkar dgon gyi mchod rten chen mo

dang / lha sa'i nub byang sa khul gyi yangs pa can dgon sogs su ldebs ris 'bor chen zhig bzhengs bskrun byas/ der ma zad khong ni phul du byung ba'i 'jim brko ba zhig kyang yin la/ brtsams chos gtso bo gong dkar dgon na nyar tshags byas yod pa dang /brtsams chos kha shas la khang brtsegs gcig dang phyed ka nas gnyis kyi mtho tshad yod/ mkhyen brtse chen mos mi tshe gang bor hur brtson sgos sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom byas pas mi tshad/ da dung phul du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal ba 'bor chen zhig kyang bskyed sring byas/ rgyud 'dzin pa 'di dag gis dus rabs 17ba'i bod kyi sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi stegs bu nas ches gal che ba'i gar gyi rnam pa zhig 'khrab ston byas/ 164〈lor/mkhyen brtse lugs kyi ris pa lho kha chos rgyal dgon gyi gsang sngags bde chen gling du ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga bar ‘‘ gsang sngags rnying ma’’ dang ‘‘ gsang sngags gsar ma'i ’’gdan rabs khrod kyi bla ma dang yi dam/chos skyong bcas kyi ldebs ris bzos pa ma zad/1654lor 'bras spungs dgon gyi chogs chen 'du khang dang tshogs chen gzhan dag nyams gso byas pa'i sgyu rtsal gsar rtsom gyi bya 'gul la'ang zhugs/ bya 'gul der khyon bsdoms sman thang lugs dang mkhyen brtse lugs kyi lha ris pa 6rdozhugs shing / de dag las phul du byung ba'i sgyu rtsal mkhan po mi 5yis grub pa'i sgyu rtsal pa'i 'go khrid tshan chung khrod/ mkhyen

brtse lugs kyi mkhan po kun dga' sangs rgyas mkhar dang zhol lha gu ge'i ming grags shin tu che/ de las gzhan/ 1669lor/ gong dkar dgon gyi dbu bzhugs ri mo ba (bon rtse) sangs rgyas mkhar gyis sgyu rtsal pa 'bor chen zhig khrid nas lam 'bras bla ma'i thang ga zhig bzhengs bskrun byas te legs grub byung /1672lor lha ris pa 50lhag gis bka' ltar ra mo che'i gzhi khyon che ba'i ldebs ris bskyar bzo byas dus/ mkhyen brtse lugs kyi ris pa gnyis kyis ‘6dbu chen ’’ (ri mo'i slob ston pa) gyi 'gan 'khur/16ṭ+wāṃ 2lor/ rgyal dbang lnga ba sku gshegs rjes/mkhyen brtse lugs kyi lha ris pa 6 2gyis dbu chen seng ge chos 'phel sogs ming grags che ba'i lugs 'di'i lha ris pa 4yis mdzub khrid 'og sman thang lugs kyi lha ris pa dang mnyam du ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga ba'i sku gdung mchod rten dang lha khang bzo bskrun gyi las su zhugs/ dus rabs 1rapa'i rjes su/ mkhyen brtse lugs kyi gsar rtsom bya 'gul la sngar bzhin 'khrug cha dod cing / bya 'gul gyi khyab khongs gtso bo lho kha sa khul du yod/ dus rabs 1〈pa'i dus stod dang dus smad nas bzung 'bri gung dgon pa'ang 'phel rgyas su phyin te lugs 'di ming grags che ba'i sgyu rtsal lte gnas gzhan zhig tu gyur/karma sgar bris kyi lugs/

rdza'i kha leb yug gcig tu 'brel bar byas yod pa dang / sbyor ba'am bshan pa/ 'bri ba/ brko ba/ldug pa sogs kyi thabs la brten nas me tog pad ma dang nyi zla/ g.yu 'brug sogs kyi ri mo rdza sked la brkos yod cing / bod ljongs rin spungs rdzong gi rdza chas la de'i skabs kyi khyad chos shin du mnga' ba red/gnyis/ lcags rigs bzo rtsal/ pa—ngacarngo ——rgyun spyod 'tsho ba'i yo byad la dgos gal che ba ོcha —— l+līsmi/dang thon skyed ca lag 'bor chen skrun pa/ chos shā lugs sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyas rgya cher phyin pa bcas kyis sgye smibod kyi lcags rigs bzo rtsal mthor 'degs su zlobatang pa ste/ lcags rigs btso sbyangs dang las hṝ snon/ sreg bcad brdar gsum bcas kyi lag rtsal lhatshoyang cha tshang ba zhig chags/ lo rgyus yig char bkod sh+lau pa ltar na/ bod kyi spyi tshogs bod rgyal thog ma gnya' —khri btsan po'i skabs nas bzung zangs lcags mnyam 193spyod kyi dus la slebs yod skad/ gnya' khri btsan po'i sngon du yang mdung phub go khrab sogs bzo ba'i lag rtsal yod pa dang / rgyal rabs nyer dgu ba khri gnyan bzung btsan gyi skabs su slebs dus lcags r+sha sto smo dzozirdogs ba'ebye shāgring dang 95sa )sdon 3) ma 95ga spyoXn 64sa /mang ‘ 5 tsho tshad mthon por slebs yod de/ gter rdo nas sta sna rī na sde—da miXcazangs lcags dngul sogs bzhu sbyangs byed pa dang / phyi weng masgrud+dha rnga sa bong ljongasajangos mda'/ gri/ mdung / shang lang bzo ba/ rji ༵ ༵༷cha sa sngon dzāng ru ko gru ba3

gtsang bo'i thog tu zam pa 'dzugs pa sogs byung // bod kyi lcags rigs bzo rtsal gyi spyod sgo dang chi/sku dmigs yul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis rigs gsum du ༷ dbye chog ste/ ( 1)'tsho ba dang thon skyed kyi yo byad dbyibs chung spus jag can gyi bzo tso de/ 'jor dang zor bas mtshon pa'i thon skyed yo bon zas byad dang bdud rtsi'i bum pa dang / chang phor/da khem bu/ thur ma/ dkar yol/ lcags thab/sla nga / dem/ rdza ma sogs kyis 'thus pa'i 'tsho ba'i yo byad yin/ ( 2)rgyan chas te/ lag gdub dang mdzub dkris/ ske rgyan/ mgo rgyan dang bzo ṭ+wāṃ bkod kyi rgyan cha/ gri dang rta sga sogs yin/ts+tshalha ( 2) chos lugs kyi yo byad de/ gtso bo lha sku gh+ri bzhengs pa dang sbubs cha/ dung chen/ rdo rje dril bu sogs bzo ba yin/lha sku bzhengs pa la spyir btang du lcags rigs 194 bzhu sbyangs dang brdar gcod/ ri mo brko ba/—— gser rtsi gtong ba/ brdar 'od 'don pa bcas kyi las rim brgyud dgos/ lha sku bzhengs dus thog mar lcags rigs kyi rdzas bzhus nas gsher gzugs su bsgyur dgos pa dang de 'khyags pa chags rjes leb mo ru gtong dgos/ lcags leb la tsha rgyag pa dang mnyam du lan mang brdung dgos/ zha smyug dang sol shing gis rtags 'bri dgos pa dang lha sku'i dbyibs su grub/ de nas steng du ri mo brkos dgos pa yin/

gser rtsi byugs pa la thog mar gser gsher gzusas su bsgyur ba dang de nas leb mo dang phra mor gtong ba/chu dang dngul chu sdebs nas 'thag pa dang 'bag par chags rjes bkol spyod byed chog gser tshon gtong rjes thog tu byi dor byed pa dang dngul chu rim pa 'ig brkus rjes me la ngar nas 'od mdangs je gsal du gtong dgos/ thabs mchog 'di yon rgyal rabs kyi — — skabs su nang log tu dar yod pa'i yig cha dag las ‘lhotshobyung / ༵ bod brgyud nang bstan gyi dgon pa dag gi li sku hūṃ smini zangs gtso bo byas te lcags rigs sna mang gis grub ñcha pa yin/ rin po che sna brgyad las grub pa'i li sku ni hṝ rin thang ches che ste rgya gar dang 'dra/ bstan bcos ljo las byung ba'i li sku bzo byed kyi sna mang rdzas ni gsham lja gsal dag yin/ ( 1)tsa na kha phye ma'i rgyu cha/ rtsol 195byung dang rang byung gnyis su mchis/ rang byung gi bsres rdzas la mdog nag po legs shos su bgrang pa /gyi yin/ rtsol byung bsres rdzas ni zangs rdzas gartsa bo byed cing nang du zha nye dang dngul sogs 'dres pa yod/bsres rdzas nang du sna mang po'i mang nyung dang kha dog gi khyad par gyis rigs mi 'dra ba'i tsa na kha phye ma sna tshogs byung pa yin/ ( 2 ) li khra/ rin po che brgyad las grub pa/ rdzas re re'i kha dog mi 'dra bas sgro' lngang

li ma'i mdog kyang rnam par bkra zhing 'ja' 'od dang mtshungs pa yin/ ( 2 ) li dkar/ dkar mdog shos che zhing de'i nang du ser bo 'dres pa'i bsres lcags rdzas kyi grub pa zhig yin/ ( 4) li ser/ser mdog gi bsres lcags rdzas shig yin/ ( 5)li dmar/ dmar mdog gi bsres rdzas shig ‘‘rang byung zangs ma’’zhes kyang 'bod pa yin/ ( 6) li smug phag mchin gyi mdog dang ldan pa'i bsres rdzas shig ste/ 'od kyi drag zhan dang bstun nas zangs ngos 'gyur ldog 'byung ba yin/ (7) li ma zangs sngo can/ (〈) ri cong / (9) rag zangs/ser zangs dang gser gnyis kyi bar du gnas pa'i bsres rdzas shig gong gsal gyi rgyu dgu bo las tsa na kha phye ma'i spyod sgo che zhing snga rabs dang mig sngar gyi li sku bzhengs dus su lhag tu de ltar snang /thon skyed dang 'tsho ba'i chu tshad mthor 'degs dang chos lugs sgyu rtsal 'phel rgyas song ba dang bstun tsho ritsho rdza trī nas lcags rigs btso sbyangs dang las snon char rjes kyi sha mo brdol ba bzhin byung pa dang / bod ljongs lha ri sa ni phal cher bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi bka' shag tre gi lcags rigs btso sbyangs byed pa dang las snon byed 'bagre sa dang lha sku bzo brkos las skrun byed sa'i lte ba ru chags yod/

gsum/ 'bag bzo'i sgru rtsal/'bag bzo'i sgyu rtsal ni 'jim rkos sgyu rtsal gyi nang tshan zhig yin zhing / bod ljongs dang mtsho sngon/kan su'u/ si khron/ yun nan bcas ljongs 'ing lnga'i bod rigs 'dus sdod sa khul du dar khyab shin du che ba yin/ de'i 'byung khungs ni gna' bo'i bod kyi snyesnabargashes rig gi rgyud mtshon ri mor dad gus byed pa dang ————gcan gzan dang 'dab chags la lad mo byas pa'i bro ‘༵tshogar dang 'das mchod sgrub pa'i cho ga sogs la 'brel sh+lau ba dam po yod cing lo rgyus shin tu ring pa yin/ byed hūṃsmilas kyi cha nas dbye na chos lugs gdong 'bag dang shā zlos gar gdong 'bag gnyis yod/ de yang snga ma la snya lha 'cham gdong 'bag dang rgyan bshams gdong t+yāX'abag gnyis yod la/ phyi mar bod kyi zlos gar k+ṣiṃ gdong 'bag dang gzhas gtam gdong 'bag gnyis /97su dbye yod/ 'jim rkos kyi rnam pa'i cha nas bltas na sne gnyis ngos mnyam pa'i dbyibs dang sne gsum 'bur gzugs can gyi dbyibs gnyis yod/ rgyu cha la bltas na ko ba'i ngo 'bag dang shing gi ngo 'bag zangs kyi ngo 'bag sa yi ngo 'bag ras kyi ngo 'bag shog bu'i ngo 'bag sogs yod/ lha 'cham ngo 'bag dang mchod bshams gdong 'bag gnyis ni gtso bo chos lugs pa'i lha'i snang brnyan dang srog

chags sna tshogs mtshon par byas yod/ lha'i mtshon byed ni gtso bo byang chub sems dpa' dang mi g.yo ba/chos skyong sogs yin/ de las chos skyong gi nyams 'gyur phun sum tshogs shing mtshon dper 'os pa yin/chos skyong gi nang don rnam pa gnyis kyis grub pa yin/dang po ni dpal ldan lha mo dang gsang bdag sogs kyi mtshon pa'i chos skyong dang / gnyis pa ni sangs rgyas chos lugs pas dbang 'du byas nas chos skyong du bkod pa ste lha gnyan btsan sogs yin/ de dag gi snang brnyan mthu dang stobs kyis phyug cing 'jigs su rung ba yin pas bdud tshogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos skyong gi nyams 'gyur ni 'di 'dra los yin snyam pa'i tshor ba sbyin pa zhig yin/ chos skyong rnam pa brgyad kyi bzo dbyibs ni chos gzhung du gtan 'khel byas yod de/ pho lha'i zhal khyim gru bzhi dang mo lha'i zhal khyim sgor mo yin/ dpral ba dkyel che zhing mig mdangs rno ba/ spyan zung 'bur tshugs su yod pa/pa spu gzengs pa/ kha gdangs shing ljags snar ba/mgo keng rus kyis rgyan pa dang sbrul lus la dkri ba sogs kyi rnam 'gyur yod/ gnyis pa ni lha'i bzo dbyibs la rang dbang ldan zhing rnam pa sgro 'dogs dang kun rtog gi cha ldan/ de dag las kha shas 'tsho ba dngos khrod kyi 'das zin pa'i mi la lad zlos byas pa'i

dngos 'bri mang po yod de/ sa skya dgon pa'i ming du grags pa'i 'phags pa'i gdong 'bag sna tshogs dang se ra dgon pa'i nyang ra rgyal chen sogs ni phul du byung pa'i mtshon byed brtsams chos kyi gras yin/zlos gar gdong 'bag ni gtso bo lha mo 'khrab ston skabs su spyod pa'i gdong 'bag la zer ba yin/bzo dbyibs kyi thad nas chos spyod gdong 'bag dang bsdur na grong ba'i rang bzhin dang dmangs khrod kyi tshon mdangs ldan/ brjod bya gtso bo ni lha mo'i zlos gar nang gi mi sna dang lha 'dre/ srog chags gsum du dbye/ mi sna'i khyad chos ldan pa'i zhib 'bri dang nang sems kyi 'gyur bas zlos gar gyi brjod gzhi'i sgrig bkod la zhabs 'degs zhu ba ni lha mo'i gdong 'bag gi ches mngon gsal dod pa'i khyad chos yin/ zlos gar byung rim khrod kyi lha 'dre dang srog chags la mi'i gshis ka dang bsam blo sbyar pa dang / mi'i rigs kyi dwangs gtsang dri ma med pa'i bsam blo dang ma rung sdig pa'i las thams cad kyang gdong 'bag gi steng nas mnyam gcig tu mtshon yod/ de dang mnyam du gdong 'bag mang che shos la kha dog mi gcig pa sna mang byugs yod pa dang kha dog re res mi sna re mtshon yod pa dper na/ dmar nag gis rgyal bo mtshon pa dang dmar skyas blon po mtshon pa/ ser bos bla ma

cung zad skam po gcod pa dang phyi shun gog nas re/gas po kha bkar rjes me la sros nas skam du 'jug rnga dang /de nas yang lci bar sbang pa dang chu la brtsa ba/ yang skam byed pa dang srab mor dra ba sogs byas nas glegs shing bzo ba yin/ par shing steng gi yigye gzugs la mdzes cha dang brjid nyams ldan dgos 'a bar grecug ri mo'ang zhor du brko dgos/ brkos tshar rjes nges par du dag bcos byed dgos shing nor ba rmams bskyar brko byas rjes mar khu'i nang sbangs pa dang rtswa chu khyad par can gyis bkru ba sogs yongs su skam/ par gyur rjes da gzod par 'debs lag char spyod chog pa yin/par rgyag shog bu ni bod yul 'a/sa ga'an du med pa'i dug rtswa zhig gis bzos pa dang des bzos/ pa'i shog bu rgyu spus ha cang legs pas 'bu srin sogs kyi gnod mi thub pa dang / yu na ring du nyar tshags thub pa sogs kyi dge mtshan ldan/ par rgyag snagye tsha ni spyir btang du stag shing dkar bo'i shun pags sbar nas byung pa'i du dreg gis grub pa yin zhing /〈bka' bstan〉ni gtso bo rgya mtshal spyad nge par brgyab pa yin/ shog bu dras rgyag pa dang snag tsha sngebs sbyong /par shing sgrig pa/ par rgyag pa/ nyi mar skam pa/dpe deb do mnyam bzo ba/ glegs shing bkru ba dang kha rgyag pa sogs go rim cha tshang zhig nges bar tshang

dgos pa yin/bod kyi dpe deb bzo ba'i rnam pa rgya nag dang mi 'dra ste/ spyir btang du legs sbyar bar bcug ma'i rnam pa dang / shog bu gru bzhi nar mo bzo ba'i dbyibs su snang / dpe deb bzo ba la phyi shog bzo ba dang / par brko ba/ ko ba'am dar gos kyi yig thum bzo ba bcas kyi las rim ldan pa yin/ phyi shog bzo byed la rgyu spus legs shing srin 'bus mi gnod pa'i shing gis byed pa la rgyun du mthong ba ni dri bsung gis phyug pa'i tsan dan yin no/ phyi shog gi dri bsung gis phyug pa'i tsan dan yin no/ phyi shog gi ngos gtsang mar byas rjes steng du dpe ming dang rgyan ris 'bri ba dang rgyan ris kyi rnam pa dpe cha'i nang don gyis thag gcod la de ni deng sang gi phyi shog jus 'god dang 'dra che ba yin/ rgyan ris la mtshon bya'i nang don ldan pa ste/ me tog pad mas khyad du 'phags pa mtshon pa dang / ral gri'i shes rab mtshon pa/ nor bu me 'bar gyis shes bya mtshon pa sogs yin zhing / ga'an yang bkra shis rtags brgyad dang chos skyong bcas kyi rgyan ris kyang yod do/shog grangs la bltas nas dpe cha legs par sgrig rjes glegs shing ka bar du btsur ba dang / de yang ched du bzos pa'i ko thum dang snam bu'i thum bshan pa ni sa rdul 'gog pa dang phrag tu 'khur chog pa/ skyel 'dren sogs la stabs bde ba'i ched du yin pa'o/ /
